prompt.name: Warrior
prompt.look: A tribal warrior of the early stone age: a friendly adult man with a strong jaw, a short dark beard, dark eyes and thick eyebrows, a plain leather headband, a sleeveless rough-woven tunic dyed bold red that ends above the knee, a brown leather belt with a bone toggle, bare muscular arms with leather wrist wraps, bare legs with leather strips wound round the shins, and plain tan leather sandals. In his right hand he holds a heavy wooden club with a rough grey stone head lashed on with leather cord. On his left arm he carries a small round wooden shield covered in tan hide, with a dark wooden rim and a plain wooden boss.
prompt.identity: the same face and short dark beard, leather headband, red tunic, belt, wrist wraps, shin wraps, sandals, stone-headed wooden club and small round hide shield
prompt.weapon_pose: The small round shield is on his left arm at the front of his body (towards the right of the image), facing right: it reaches from his chin down to his waist, and its lower edge stays above the hem of the tunic. His club arm is held out in front of the shield at chest height, gripping the club by its handle, with the club rising almost straight up to the right of the shield, clear of it with background visible between them. The club is nowhere near the ground.
prompt.attack: (1) ready stance, club raised, shield in front of the chest; (2) drawing the club back behind his shoulder, weight shifting back; (3) stepping forward and raising the club high overhead; (4) the club swinging down and forward to the right over the top of the shield, his arm extended; (5) the club low and out to the right beyond the shield, body leaning forward, front knee bent; (6) back to the ready stance. The shield stays on his left arm in front of his chest in every frame, and the whole club stays visible, never hidden behind the shield. No motion arc or trail.
prompt.damage_gear: a scuffed, dented shield and a chipped club head
prompt.damage_gear_critical: a split shield rim, a torn tunic and a cracked club handle, still in his hands
prompt.defeat_prop: the club still held loosely in his hand and the shield still on his arm

states.note: walk built in code from the master and from each damage drawing; the legs alternate by construction
